name: AddictionSeverityIndex
title: Comprehensive Assessment / Addiction Severity Index
description: Comprehensive intake assessment across seven domains — general information, medical, employment and support, alcohol and drug use, legal, family and social, and psychiatric status. Each domain closes with an interviewer severity rating and confidence ratings.
